items.name: Introdução
items.content: {"json":"## Grader · Avaliações, integrações e erros\nOs dados aparecem quando o serviço exporta **OpenTelemetry/Application Insights**. Avaliações e jobs devem receber métricas de negócio adicionais; o total de requests HTTP não equivale ao total de avaliações."}

items.name: Requisições por role
items.content:
{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize Requests=count(), Falhas=countif(Success == false), P95_ms=round(percentile(DurationMs,95),1) by AppRoleName, Name
| top 40 by Requests desc","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","resourceIds":["__LOG_ANALYTICS_WORKSPACE_ID__"],"visualization":"table","size":0,"timeContext":{"durationMs":86400000}}

items.name: Dependências externas
items.content:
{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize Chamadas=count(), Falhas=countif(Success == false), P95_ms=round(percentile(DurationMs,95),1) by AppRoleName, Target, Type
| top 30 by Chamadas desc","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","resourceIds":["__LOG_ANALYTICS_WORKSPACE_ID__"],"visualization":"table","size":0,"timeContext":{"durationMs":86400000}}

items.name: Exceções
items.content:
{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"AppExceptions
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize Ocorrencias=count() by AppRoleName, ExceptionType, bin(TimeGenerated,1d)
| order by TimeGenerated desc","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","resourceIds":["__LOG_ANALYTICS_WORKSPACE_ID__"],"visualization":"table","size":0,"timeContext":{"durationMs":86400000}}

items.name: Métricas customizadas disponíveis
items.content:
{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize Registros=count(), Total=sum(Sum) by AppRoleName, Name
| top 30 by Registros desc","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","resourceIds":["__LOG_ANALYTICS_WORKSPACE_ID__"],"visualization":"table","size":0,"timeContext":{"durationMs":86400000}}
